outcome: Regression, persistence, or progression of CIN 2/3
finding: Colposcopy demonstrated a high accuracy rate (89.2%) for detecting cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) 2/3 during pregnancy, and vaginal delivery was associated with a higher rate of CIN regression.
